messages:
Taylor H.: Quick pre-oncall sync — I'm on for the night shift starting 2026-03-18 21:00 UTC. Can folks confirm: pager access, VPN cert validity, runbook visibility, grafana dashboards? Leaving a checklist here so handoff is smooth.
Samir K.: Pager tested earlier, ack/resolve flow worked (ack via mobile). VPN cert on my Mac expires 2026-03-20, so I'll rotate before my next shift.
Alex P.: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-runtime — I pushed a small edit to the "GPU pool failover" section (step 2). @Taylor H. can you confirm you see the change?
Taylor H.: I see it now, Alex. Also added a short note to prefer cpu-fallback for non-prod during prolonged outages. :white_check_mark:
Mika (oncall mgr): Heads up — bastion SSH key rotation scheduled 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. If you're covering that window, make sure you have Secrets Manager read access or grab the emergency key I’ll place in the oncall vault. Tagging infra.
infra-bot: Automated: Secret rotation scheduled for path /prod/bastion/key on 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z. Ensure role `oncall-readonly` has `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` before rotation.
Samir K.: I don't have secretsmanager access in prod right now. @Mika (oncall mgr) can you open a quick IAM ticket or attach the role to the oncall group?
Mika (oncall mgr): Opening ticket now. Temporary mitigation: uploaded an emergency key to Vault at https://vault.redwood/internal/temporary-keys/oncall/night-2026-03-23 (TTL 6h). Use only if you can't access Secrets Manager.
Taylor H.: I validated the SSH step in the runbook using that vault key — successful connection and sudo checks. Also muted non-prod noisy alert for `inference-latency-p95` for the shift and noted it in the runbook.
Alex P.: Quick FYI: Pager rule for `model-serving-outage` goes to Tier 1 -> 10m -> Tier 2. If Tier 1 doesn't respond, escalate to #eng-sre. Added the escalation play in the runbook under "pager handling."
Taylor H.: Planning a smoke from corp VPN and from the zero-trust tester before handoff: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .` should return 200. If it fails, open PD and annotate with the curl output.
Samir K.: Will test both networks and paste results here. :thumbsup:
Mika (oncall mgr): Checklist summary posted: runbook updated, pager verified, VPN noted (cert exp 3/20 for Samir), emergency vault key staged, grafana muted for noisy non-prod alert. If anything else pops up, drop it here or DM. Thanks team!
Taylor H.: Thanks — I'll post a final handoff note 30m before my shift with any last-minute issues.
